observations.label: connected-announcement-1
observations.text:
You see a marlback scrabbler.

A short-faced bank burrower with a broad back of
overlapping shale plates. Its grasping foreclaws
rake loose earth into low walls around the burrow
mouth.
It guards the ground around that sack. Heed its
warning and withdraw to avoid a fight; an attack is
remembered.
